transcript: Outsiders fans, did you know you can now stay at an outsiders themed hotel room? I was invited to go check out the new Stay Gold Suite at the Chatwal Hotel, which is located in the heart of the theater district. This room was actually designed by two Broadway performers, Krista Rodriguez and Tyler Logan. There are so many cool details in this room, like this projector wall which will make you feel like you're sitting in a 1960s drive in. The room also comes stocked with some custom themed stuff. Snacks including movie theater popcorn and these two Coke cans that say Ponyboy and Soda Pop. And of course a record player stocked with the outsiders vinyl. They also have a merch closet where you can shop the merchandise from the Broadway show from the comfort of your hotel room. Then you have the bathroom which is themed around the famous rumble scene in the rain. The walls of the bathroom are adorned with photographs from the show, and of course they also have a rain shower head for a truly immersive experience. They also have these really cute stay gold towels and a custom stay gold robe. And finally, the price! Bookings for this room include two complimentary tickets to see the show, a complimentary Stay Gold cocktail, a 100 dollar property credit, as well as some fun keepsakes that you can only get through this collaboration. So with all of that being said, bookings for this room Start at $1,150 per night.
